chapters.text:
This book began from an imported campaign. Its founding details were incomplete.

The founding party of 10 residents arrived. Aodhín and Leofweard were already partners at arrival. Halldis Sigurdardóttir and Mieppi were already partners at arrival. Leofgifu and Mieppi were already partners at arrival. Our longship was salvaged.
